question: Find out how many actors have a 'Shahrukh number' of 2? This means they acted in a film with someone who acted with Shahrukh Khan, but not directly with him.
sql:
-- Step 1: Get all people who acted with Shah Rukh Khan (Shahrukh number 1)
WITH srk_pid AS (
    SELECT PID FROM Person WHERE TRIM(Name) = 'Shah Rukh Khan'
),
srk_movies AS (
    SELECT MID FROM M_Cast WHERE TRIM(PID) IN (SELECT PID FROM srk_pid)
),
direct_actors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(mc.PID) AS actor_pid
    FROM M_Cast mc
    WHERE mc.MID IN (SELECT MID FROM srk_movies)
    AND TRIM(mc.PID) != (SELECT PID FROM srk_pid)
),
-- Step 2: Get all actors who acted with direct_actors (potential Shahrukh number 2)
co_actors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(mc.PID) AS actor_pid
    FROM M_Cast mc
    WHERE mc.MID IN (SELECT MID FROM M_Cast WHERE TRIM(PID) IN (SELECT actor_pid FROM direct_actors))
    AND TRIM(mc.PID) != (SELECT PID FROM srk_pid)
    AND TRIM(mc.PID) NOT IN (SELECT actor_pid FROM direct_actors)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_shahrukh_2 FROM co_actors
